text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I spotted Nakayama Festa standing near the classroom entrance, gazing at her classmates.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'm just deciding whether I should go
with someone from the class next door
or someone from my own class.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
“—We're in the same class, huh.
Then...”

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Acute, I have a small favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh my, what could it be?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Lend me your English and math notes.
We have a quiz next week, right?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, you always did look so cozy sleeping away.
Sure thing, feel free to use my notes if they'll help.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —Thanks a bunch.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Shut up, Acute already said it's fine.
Keep your nose out of this.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "It's totally fine! I mean, you're super busy with training and races too, aren't you, Nakayama-chan? It's only natural to get sleepy during class."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's only natural that Twinkle Series races take priority.
I'm the same way, after all. So let's help each other out.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
—Still, I wonder...
Could my notebook really be of help to Nakayama-chan?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, what does this note mean?
'PR.58~ âTense Q'...?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that means it's related to the tense questions
starting on page 58 of the workbook.
The black stars are related exercises, and the white stars are references.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...The rest are full of symbols too.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: That's right~. I can't write very fast, so I came up with my own symbols to use instead. It really is hard to read, isn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: —Shall we study together then?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? ...No, all I really need
is to borrow your notebook—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I use this notebook too, so it's much more
helpful if we study at our own pace together.
...Right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Aaaalright, I get it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...You really have to stick your nose
into everything, don't you...? Fine, pick.
English or math, which one are we doing first?
choice_data_list: Essential English for breaking through the walls of the world!
Math that helps with understanding strategy.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: English, huh... Listening to it makes me so sleepy...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, in that case, want to try my study method?
It'll blow your drowsiness right away~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Referencing Wonder Acute's notes,
I read aloud the English textbook passage.
As for Nakayama Festa and the others listening...

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
...Huff... huff...!
...Hoh... hoh...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Wonder Acute's study method was to solve problems while doing physical training!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Isn't this the kind of thing...
usually reserved for when you get an answer WRONG...?!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That wouldn't be much of a workout, now would it?
Besides, I came up with this method in the first place
so I wouldn't have to cut back on training time~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If I want to win in the Twinkle Series,
this is the bare minimum I have to do.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
choice_data_list: Pop quiz! Why was Stevie so angry?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes! "He was in a bad mood 
to begin with"!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, correct answer~.
Guess that means we'll have to add an extra 20kg to Nakayama-chan's barbell.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Tch... Well, that's competition for ya.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: An' for me, add 30kg to the barbell.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Why's Acute, the winner, carrying the
heavier one? Isn't this supposed to be a punishment game?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Why? Because pushing yourself harder sharpens your focus.
The heavier the load, the more effective it is, you know.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Now then, shall we move on to the next question?
Want to do full squats this time?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hah... Haha, hahahahaha!
Are you serious... that's insane!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—However, that's what makes it fun! I'm not folding.
Let's see this through to the bitter end!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A fiery spirit ignites in Nakayama Festa's eyes.
—Thus, she not only prepared for the quiz,
but also trained her Power, killing two birds with one stone!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Leave math to me.
Lately, all my educated guesses have been hitting the mark.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, that'd be a big help~
Please do teach me too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Was cramming only what might be on the test really a good way to study...? For now, they decided to move somewhere they could talk freely.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
“—The next quiz is on... quadratic inequalities!
I'm gonna bet everything on this one topic!”

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: So yeah, Acute, if there were any questions highlighted during class, let me know.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... There was that problem about throwing a ball upward...
Ah, she also said to check quadratic functions because they're related.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Also, regarding this velocity problem.
You solve this using a quadratic equation, right?
choice_data_list: Speed calculations can be applied to racing too.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I see... Guess I'll go check that out too, then.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Also, she said there are a lot of word problems with geometry,
so make sure to review your geometric formulas too.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...A plus shape, I see.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: And also, according to the notes in my notebook—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—...Hey. We ended up reviewing
the entire test scope, damn it!
choice_data_list: That was a worthwhile study session!
That was a worthwhile study session, wasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...You noticed and kept quiet, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. When something catches my eye,
I just can't rest easy until I check it out...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Well, fine. Watching Acute has given me
a pretty good read on how meticulous folks think.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Just means the bet got a whole lot easier to read.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through the study session, Nakayama Festa gained
a much deeper understanding of race tactics and mind games!
